preview.tournamentOverview: The 3M Open returns to TPC Twin Cities, a par-71 track that rewards accurate iron play over raw length. It's the first full-field event after The Open Championship, drawing a mix of players fresh off Royal Birkdale and others who used the week to rest.
preview.modelExplainer: This week's course weights lean heavily on SG Approach (25.8%) and SG Total (22.8%), with SG Off-the-Tee and Around-the-Green playing secondary roles. Driving accuracy and bogey avoidance carry only marginal weight, reflecting a course that punishes poor iron play more than a stray tee shot.
preview.pickApproach: Recommendations are frozen deterministically from verified sportsbook prices and a provisional field-relative model before this prose is written; this section explains that process in plain English for readers.

article.title: 3M Open Betting Preview: Deterministic Model Targets at TPC Twin Cities
article.dek: A course-weighted model and verified sportsbook prices set this week's board -- no editorial player selection.
article.introduction: The tour heads to TPC Twin Cities for the 3M Open. This week's recommendations come from a deterministic candidate/threshold pipeline against verified market prices, not editorial judgement.

keyTakeaways.text: The top model-ranked player in the frozen selection anchors the outright targets.

sections.heading: The Tournament
sections.body: TPC Twin Cities is an approach-first track, and this week's model weights SG Approach above every other category at 25.8%.

sections.heading: How the Board Was Built
sections.body: Every recommendation below cleared a probability floor, a probability-edge threshold, and an expected-value threshold against a verified sportsbook price before publication.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Scottie Scheffler is the top model-ranked player among the frozen outright recommendations, priced at a verified sportsbook line.

article.conclusion: This week's board reflects deterministic thresholds against verified prices, not an editorial judgement call.
